projects.title: AI Network Traffic Analysis Agent
projects.description: AI agent that analyzes packet captures and flags anomalous traffic patterns automatically, using an LLM reasoning layer to explain findings in plain language instead of manual packet-by-packet review in Wireshark.

projects.title: SOC Alert Triage Agent
projects.description: AI-augmented triage assistant that ingests Suricata/Zeek alerts via Wazuh, then enriches, deduplicates, and prioritizes them by severity and false-positive likelihood to speed up incident response.

projects.title: Cloud IAM Least-Privilege Auditor
projects.description: Scans AWS IAM policies for overly permissive roles and unused access, then uses an LLM to explain the risk and auto-draft a tightened, least-privilege Terraform policy as the fix.
